title: Greenhouse normalized inventory search
description: Search stored jobs from selected supported Greenhouse boards. Complete original descriptions, advanced filters and independent optional owner-funded AI enrichment and English translation. Both options default off; no source website is requested.

schemaVersion.title: Input format
schemaVersion.description: Version marker for database-only normalized job search.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs
maxItems.description: Maximum returned jobs. Zero means 200. Enrichment and filters may produce fewer matches.

postedWithin.title: Posted within
postedWithin.description: Filter by the stored posting date, or first inventory admission date when no source date was available. Refreshes do not reset it. Use any or a positive h/d/w/m duration of at most 36500 days.

workArrangements.title: Work arrangements
workArrangements.description: Optional remote, hybrid, or onsite filter; empty means all.

dedupe.title: Repeat-delivery suppression
dedupe.description: Suppress confirmed repeat deliveries for the same Apify user and search. Disable it for a stateless run.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Use the persistent tenant-isolated delivery ledger.

key.title: Scope key
key.description: Optional stable alert/profile key; leave empty to derive the scope from this search.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Case-insensitive phrase matched against the stored title, employer, and complete original description.

accuracy.title: AI accuracy
accuracy.description: Compatibility override for aiEnrichment.accuracy. Prefer the accuracy field inside aiEnrichment; when this field is explicitly supplied, it takes precedence.

filters.title: Advanced filters
filters.description: Versioned filters over normalized fields. With enrichment off, only stored source facts are evaluated; unknown values do not satisfy ordinary comparisons.

schemaVersion.title: Filter schema version
schemaVersion.description: Version marker for the shared normalized job-filter contract.

expression.description: Validated by the shared filter parser: all/any/not groups or allowlisted field/operator/value predicates, at most 8 levels and 100 predicates. Invalid expressions fail before inventory or owner-provider work.
expression.title: Filter expression

aiEnrichment.title: AI enrichment
aiEnrichment.description: Optional owner-funded enrichment fills unknown fields. Disabled by default. No customer API key is required.

enabled.title: Enable AI enrichment
enabled.description: Fill unknown normalized fields with owner-funded AI and preserve source facts.

accuracy.title: AI accuracy
accuracy.description: Choose the owner-funded enrichment profile when enrichment is enabled.

translateToEnglish.title: Translate display text to English
translateToEnglish.description: Translate selected display fields using the owner service. Original descriptions remain unchanged. Independent of AI enrichment; disabled by default.

boards.title: Boards
boards.description: Select qualified board IDs. Only Stripe and Figma are supported. The inventory must be ready for every selected board; this request never crawls or enrolls a board.

includeRaw.title: Retain original descriptions
includeRaw.description: Complete original descriptions and HTML are always retained. False is not supported.

greenhouse.title: Legacy Greenhouse selection
greenhouse.description: Compatibility input only with nomad-agent-job-search-input-v1. New requests use top-level boards. Do not supply both forms.

schemaVersion.title: Legacy source format
schemaVersion.description: Version marker for the previous nested Greenhouse board selection.

boards.title: Boards
boards.description: Select qualified board IDs. Only Stripe and Figma are supported. The inventory must be ready for every selected board; this request never crawls or enrolls a board.
